q: Which message type runs your code when the app is in the background?
why: Notification messages are shown by the OS tray instead.

q: For a 'ring now' message you should set …
o: high priority and a TTL of a few minutes
normal priority and a TTL of four weeks
why: A stale ring is worse than no ring.

q: How does your server authenticate to the FCM HTTP v1 API?
why: The legacy server-key API has been shut down (verify).

q: It is fine to put a user's private message text in the push payload.
why: Send an id and fetch the content from your own API; the payload passes through Google and is size-limited.
